title: U-heroes
description: U-Heroes is a Forge 1.20.1 mod that introduces a nanotech-powered hero progression system, featuring the NanoSuit, advanced combat mechanics, Neural Flux energy, and cinematic cutscenes.
body:
# 🧾 Changelog — U-Heroes v0.1.0 (Alpha)

## 🚀 Initial Release
First public alpha version of **U-Heroes**.

---

## 🦸 Core Systems Added

### 🛡️ NanoSuit System
- Added full NanoSuit armor set (Helmet, Chestplate, Leggings, Boots)
- Implemented set bonus system:
  - 2 pieces → Speed boost
  - 3 pieces → Speed + Strength
  - 4 pieces → Full activation (regeneration + enhanced effects)
- Added self-repair mechanics
- Integrated Curios compatibility

---

### ⚔️ Combat System
- Added **Laser Sword**
- Implemented combo-based attack system (up to 10 hits)
- Added directional VFX slashes
- Energy-based damage scaling on late combo hits

---

### ⚡ Neural Flux System
- Introduced Neural Flux energy resource
- Custom HUD bar for energy display
- Energy consumption tied to abilities and combat
- Passive regeneration system

---

## 🌍 World & Resources

### ⛏️ NanoAlloy
- New ore generation (Y-level 0–32)
- Used for advanced crafting recipes

### 🌿 Life Essence
- Rare drop from leaves (~2% chance)
- Required for nanotech crafting progression

---

## 🎬 Events & Entities
- Added **Asteroid Impact Event** on world start
- Introduced **NanoCreature** entity (nanobot origin system)
- Basic cutscene integration for immersion

---

## 🎨 Visuals & Audio
- Added custom 3D armor models (GeckoLib)
- Implemented animation system for weapons and entities
- Added particle effects (AAAParticles integration)
- Custom sounds for NanoSuit and weapons

---

## 📖 Guide System
- Added in-game guide book (Patchouli)
- Includes categories:
  - Introduction
  - Equipment
  - Abilities
  - Crafting
  - Lore

---

## ⚙️ Technical
- Built for **Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge 47.4.10)**
- Integrated:
  - GeckoLib
  - Player Animator
  - Curios API
  - Cloth Config
  - AAAParticles

---

## ⚠️ Known Issues
- Balance is not finalized
- Some abilities may feel over/underpowered
- Minor visual or animation glitches may occur
- Guide book may require fixes in some builds

---

## 🧪 Notes
This is an **early alpha build** intended for testing core systems.

Feedback is highly appreciated and will directly influence future updates.
